P.name: Duelist's Dance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Fiora''' identifies the {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} of nearby enemy champions, marked as an arc around them in North-, East-, South- or Westward direction. {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} take {{fd|1.75}} seconds to become targetable and linger for {{fd|13.25}} seconds afterwards while '''Fiora''' remains near the target, otherwise the {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will disappear. After a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} expires, '''Fiora''' identifies a new one on her target.
P.description2: Dealing damage in the direction of a {{as|Vital|buzzword}} will trigger it to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 4% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}, {{tip|heal}} '''Fiora''' for {{pplevel|35 to 100|color=heal}}, and grant her {{pp|type=[[File:Grand Challenge.png|20px|link=]] ''Grand Challenge's'' Rank|key=%|20 to 50 for 4|0 to 3|formula=20%+(10%*Grand Challenge's Rank)|color=ms}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|1.85}} seconds.

Q.name: Lunge
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then stabs a nearby enemy based on {{tt|a priority|See notes}}. ''Lunge'' can hit {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|ward|wards}}. Stabbing a target reduces ''Lunge's'' {{sti|cooldown}} by 50%.
Q.description2: The stab deals {{as|physical damage}} and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
Q.description3: '''''Fiora''' can cast any of her {{tip|abilities}} during the dash. The target does not have to be {{tip|sight|visible}} to be hit by this ability, unless it is a ward.''

W.name: Riposte
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' enters a defensive stance for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, during which she is {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}, prevents all incoming non-{{tip|turret}} damage, and gains {{tip|debuff}} immunity.
W.description2: Additionally, over the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds of the duration, '''Fiora''' poises to strike, after which she sends a shock with her sword in a line in the target direction, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all enemies hit until colliding with an enemy champion.
W.description3: The enemy champion struck is also {{tip|slow|slowed}} and {{tip|cripple|crippled}} by 25% for 2 seconds. If ''Riposte'' negates at least one {{tt|hostile|Belonging to an enemy source}} {{tip|immobilize|immobilizing}} effect, '''Fiora''' {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for the same duration instead.

E.name: Bladework
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' empowers her next two [[basic attack]]s {{tip|on-attack}} within 4 seconds to gain {{sti|range|25 '''bonus''' range}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}.
E.description2: The first attack {{tip|slow|slows}} the target by 30% for 1 second but cannot {{tip|critically strike}}. The second attack will {{tip|critically strike}} for {{sti|critical damage modifiers|{{as|'''modified''' critical damage}}}}, including to {{tip|turrets|structures}}.

R.name: Grand Challenge
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Fiora''' challenges the target enemy champion for 8 seconds, highlighting all four of their {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} after a {{fd|0.5}}-second delay. While in effect, ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' does not identify new {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} on ''Grand Challenge's'' target, and unlike ''{{ai|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'', ''Grand Challenge's'' {{as|Vitals|buzzword}} will linger regardless of range.
R.description3: While near the target, '''Fiora''' gains ''{{ais|Duelist's Dance|Fiora}}'' {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}.
R.description4: If '''Fiora''' triggers at least one {{as|Vital|buzzword}} before the target {{tip|death|dies}}, or triggers all four otherwise, a ''{{ai|Grand Challenge 2|Fiora|Victory Zone}}'' is created on their death location for 5 seconds, which {{tip|heal|heals}} '''Fiora''' and all allies within the area every {{fd|0.25}} seconds.
R.leveling4: {{st|Heal per Tick|{{ap|75/4 to 125/4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/4}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Heal per Second|{{ap|75 to 125}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|75*5 to 125*5}} {{as|(+ 300% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
